label: Thomas Aquinas, Summa theologiae I q.46 a.2…: ST I q.46 a.2 ad 7 supports the weaker reading of…
locator: I q.46 a.2 ad 7: generat enim inquantum homo, et non inquantum est filius alterius hominis
interpretation: Reading B. The criterion of accidentality is 'inquantum': the man generates as man, not as son. That criterion concerns relevance to the causing, not time, so it would equally make a present but irrelevant being-moved accidental. On this reading the passage favors the relevant-respect reading of the per se premise, and the interpretive argument for the strong reading loses its no-counter-evidence premise.
